resolution: Ragung is OPEN and bookable, but only on Wed Oct 21, 2026 (high confidence; checked live on Yanolja/NOL on Oct 6, 2026). Yanolja shows 901 reviews, including ones dated Feb, Apr and Jul 2026 and one '3 days ago'. Kakao Map shows it as 신라밀레니엄 라궁호텔 at 55-12 Expo-ro with no closed flag, phone 054-776-0071 (not the +82-54-778-2100 in heritage.json). NOL World (English Yanolja) also lists it (NC-11074). Wed Oct 21 for 3 adults: Suite Madang-type or Numaru-type, each with a private outdoor hot-spring bath, 170,000 KRW (2 rooms left of each), plus 30,000 KRW for the 3rd adult paid on site = 200,000 KRW. If the 3rd person wants their own bedding instead of sharing the double bed/futon, add 25,000 KRW (subject to stock) = 225,000 KRW. The Royal Suite with an indoor hot-spring bath is 240,000 (1 left), so 270,000-295,000 KRW for 3. Free cancellation until Oct 14 17:00. No breakfast: none is sold, and 2026 reviews say it was suspended. Tue Oct 20, Thu Oct 22, Mon Oct 19 and Fri Oct 23 are all SOLD OUT on Yanolja. Real price for 3 is about 200-225k KRW (about US$145-165), below the 280-450k estimate in heritage.json. The onsen-ryokan element can stay in Gyeongju only if the plan puts the Gyeongju night on Wed Oct 21 and books now. Fallbacks for the same dates are mostly sold out or limited. Hwangnamguan is sold out Oct 20-22. Lahan Select is sold out Oct 21-22, with Oct 20 at 215k. Hilton has no room for 3 below about 843k. Sono Calm is 260k (Oct 21), The-K Hotel 180k (Oct 21, Bomun hot-spring sauna), Commodore about 180k (Oct 21) and Kolon 171k (Oct 21, near Bulguksa). Commodore and Kolon are confirmed open.

lodging.name: Gyeongju Ragung Hotel (Lagung)
lodging.room_for_3: All 16 suites are base 2 / max 4, with 1 double bed + 1 futon (ondol). The 3rd adult pays 30,000 KRW on site. Extra bedding is 25,000 KRW if available. No extra beds.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Yanolja, Oct 6, 2026, Wed Oct 21 for 3 adults: Suite Madang-type 170,000 (2 left) or Suite Numaru-type 170,000 (2 left), Royal Suite (indoor hot-spring bath) 240,000 (1 left). Add 30,000 for the 3rd adult on site, so 200,000 / 270,000 for 3, plus 25,000 if a 3rd bedding set is wanted. The cheaper 'walk-in special' (165,000; surcharge if arriving by car) is sold out. Tue Oct 20, Thu Oct 22, Mon Oct 19 and Fri Oct 23 are ALL SOLD OUT. Free cancellation until Oct 14 17:00. No breakfast is sold (reviews say it was suspended). Drip-bag coffee is included.
lodging.highlights: Confirmed operating in 2026: 901 Yanolja reviews (4.6), including Jul 2026 and '3 days ago'. Every suite has a private hot-spring bath (outdoor; the Royal Suite also has an indoor one), with slippery-soft onsen water, warm ondol rooms and a hanok courtyard. This is the closest Korean analog to the Izu ryokan. Bookable in English via NOL World (world.nol.com NC-11074).
lodging.drawbacks: Only Wed Oct 21 is available, with 5 rooms left. No breakfast or dinner, unlike a Japanese ryokan. Some reviews mention poor soundproofing, stiff doors and some dust in the outdoor tub. Needs a taxi or bus from Gyeongju Station or downtown (about 15-20 min). Kakao rating 3.3 (9 ratings) vs Yanolja 4.6 (901).

lodging.name: Hwangnamguan Hanok Hotel
lodging.area: Downtown Hwangnam-dong, 3 min walk to Hwangridan-gil, walkable to Daereungwon-Cheomseongdae-Donggung & Wolji
lodging.room_for_3: 'Ondol 3-person' (base 3 / max 4, 3 floor bedding sets) or Ondol Suite (base 3). Extra person 25,000 KRW (with bedding). No extra beds, no bathtubs.
lodging.price_note: Yanolja, Oct 6, 2026: SOLD OUT on Tue Oct 20, Wed Oct 21 and Thu Oct 22, for 3 adults and also for 2. Listed (sold-out) rates for Oct 21: Ondol 3-person 146,000, Ondol Suite 156,000, Family Suite 259,000. No breakfast.
lodging.highlights: 51 rooms, English-speaking front desk until 02:00, free hanbok try-on for guests, best location for the night walk.
lodging.drawbacks: Not available on any target night on Yanolja. Floor bedding, no breakfast, no onsen.
lodging.booking: nol.yanolja.com/stay/domestic/3012569; check Agoda/Booking for separate inventory (not checked)

lodging.name: Hilton Gyeongju
lodging.room_for_3: Standard rooms are max 2 on Yanolja and no bedding can be added. On hilton.com only suites take 3.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Oct 6, 2026: hilton.com (code KYOHITW) for 3 adults shows 21 of 23 room types sold out on Oct 20 and 21; only Executive Suites are left at ₩3.28-4.96M. On Oct 22 a Deluxe Family Suite is ₩842,902 (incl. 10% service, excl. tax). On Yanolja, Deluxe Twin/Double at 230,000 (Oct 22) is max 2 people. lodging.highlights: Open and operating; indoor pool, sauna 16,500 KRW.
lodging.drawbacks: Effectively unavailable or unaffordable for 3 on these dates.

lodging.name: Lahan Select Gyeongju
lodging.room_for_3: Deluxe Twin Mountain View is base 3 (1 double + 1 single), so there is no 3rd-person fee. Extra bed 40,000 KRW.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Yanolja Oct 6, 2026: Tue Oct 20, Deluxe Twin Mountain (base 3) 215,000 room-only special / 240,000 standard / 260,000 with pool for 2. Family Twin (2 doubles) 235,000. Wed Oct 21 and Thu Oct 22 are SOLD OUT. Breakfast is not included (48,000 per adult). Sauna 30,000 (50% off for guests).
lodging.highlights: 5-star lakeside; base-3 rooms fit 3 without an extra bed.
lodging.drawbacks: Only Oct 20 is available; no hot spring; breakfast expensive.

lodging.name: Sono Calm Gyeongju
lodging.room_for_3: Deluxe Suite A is base 3 / max 4 (1 double + 1 single), so there is no 3rd-person fee. The resort has no extra beds; extra bedding is 25,000 KRW.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Yanolja Oct 6, 2026: Wed Oct 21, Deluxe Suite A (no view) 260,000 room-only, 340,000 with breakfast for 2, or 350,000 with Pool & Spa for 2. Lake view 291,000. Oct 20 from 291,000. Oct 22 SOLD OUT. Breakfast not included in the base rate.
lodging.highlights: Spacious suite; Wellness Pool & Spa (outdoor infinity pool) on site.
lodging.drawbacks: Priciest available fallback; the spa is a pool/water facility, not a hot-spring bath.

lodging.name: The-K Hotel Gyeongju
lodging.area: Bomun (400 m from the tourist complex), view of Hwangnyongwon
lodging.room_for_3: Ondol Triple is base 3 / max 3 with 3 single beds, so it needs no extra bed. Extra bed elsewhere 40,000 KRW.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Yanolja Oct 6, 2026: Wed Oct 21, Ondol Triple (3 single beds) 180,000 room-only (4 left) or 225,000 with breakfast for 2. The 3rd breakfast is 32,000 on site. Oct 20 from 170,000; Oct 22 from 325,000 (higher). Hot-spring sauna (온천사우나) with an open-air bath costs 10,000 per adult for guests, open 06:00-21:00, closed Mondays (open Wed).
lodging.highlights: The best-value Bomun property with its own hot-spring bath: a public hot-spring sauna with an outdoor tub (reviews: 'hot-spring water, open-air bath'). Good Korean restaurant (Mugunghwa).
lodging.drawbacks: Shared public bath, not private as at Ragung. Floors 6 and 8 are under renovation Jul 6-Nov 2, 2026 (noise 08:30-17:00). Older public-sector hotel.

lodging.name: Commodore Hotel Gyeongju
lodging.room_for_3: Deluxe Triple is 2 singles + 1 double (max 4) with no per-person surcharge. Extra bed 36,300; bedding 20,000.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Yanolja Oct 6, 2026: OPEN. Wed Oct 21, Deluxe Triple Mountain 179,550 member / 189,000, or 217,550 with breakfast for 2. Lake view 189,050. Breakfast 33,000 per adult. Oct 20 from 170,050. Oct 22 not checked.
lodging.highlights: Confirmed operating; beds for 3 without an extra bed; sauna (06-21, closed Mon, 50% off for guests).
lodging.drawbacks: Sauna is not described as a hot spring; dated 4-star.

lodging.name: Kolon Hotel Gyeongju
lodging.room_for_3: Premier Super Twin is base 4 with 2 double beds, so there is no fee for 3.
lodging.price_note: LIVE Yanolja Oct 6, 2026: OPEN. Wed Oct 21, Premier Super Twin 171,000 room-only, 194,000 with breakfast for 2 + sauna for 2, or 271,000 with breakfast for 4. Premier Ondol (renovated 2025) 193,000 + 11,000 for the 3rd person. Oct 20 from 122,000; Oct 22 from 194,000. Breakfast 45,000 per adult.
lodging.highlights: Confirmed operating; walk to Bulguksa at dawn; 'Moonlight pocha' terrace with unlimited beer and makgeolli 19,900.
lodging.drawbacks: Far from downtown night sights; sauna 22,000 (50% off for guests).

tips: Book Ragung for Wed Oct 21 now (5 suites left as of Oct 6). Free cancellation lasts until Oct 14 17:00, so it is a free hold while the itinerary shape is settled.
Ragung total for 3: 170,000 online + 30,000 on site = 200,000 KRW (+25,000 for a third bedding set). That is about US$143-149 at 1,340-1,400 KRW/US$.
Bring breakfast or eat out: Ragung sells no breakfast. Note that Ragung's 'walk-in special' rate adds an on-site surcharge if you arrive by car; a taxi is fine.

If the Gyeongju night must be Oct 20 or 22, the best on-theme fallback is The-K Hotel Gyeongju (Oct 20 from 170k). Its hot-spring sauna has an outdoor bath (10,000 pp) and its Ondol Triple has 3 single beds.
Ragung is also listed in English on NOL World (world.nol.com NC-11074), for foreign cards without a Korean phone.
warnings: Gyeongju weekdays Oct 19-23, 2026 are unusually full: Ragung is sold out every night except Oct 21, Hwangnamguan is sold out Oct 20-22, Lahan is sold out Oct 21-22, and Hilton has only suites. The cause is unconfirmed; it may be the autumn school-trip season. Agoda/Booking.com/Trip.com inventory was not checked and may differ.
The Ragung phone +82-54-778-2100 in heritage.json is unverified; Kakao Map lists 054-776-0071.
Hilton Gyeongju standard rooms are max 2 with no added bedding; a party of 3 needs a suite (from ₩842,902 on Oct 22).
The-K Hotel is renovating floors 6 and 8 until Nov 2, 2026 (daytime noise); its sauna is closed on Mondays.
